visual_briefs.title: Vertical slices between two curves
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show top-minus-bottom slice height and accumulated region.
visual_briefs.composition: Curves y=2x and y=x^2 on [0,2], movable vertical slice.
visual_briefs.long_description: A vertical strip extends from lower curve x^2 to upper curve 2x; its height is 2x-x^2.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Keep graph scale equal enough that region shape is not misleading.

visual_briefs.title: A solid assembled from cross-sectional slices
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show a base interval, one cross-section, and stacked slices.
visual_briefs.composition: Perspective diagram with x-axis, slice thickness dx, cross-sectional area A(x), and volume sum.
visual_briefs.long_description: A solid is decomposed into thin slabs; each slab volume is approximately A(x)dx.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not imply slices are literally infinitesimal physical objects.

visual_briefs.title: Washer geometry
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show outer radius, inner radius, and thickness for rotation around a horizontal axis.
visual_briefs.composition: Region and a representative vertical slice rotated into a washer; labeled R(x), r(x), dx.
visual_briefs.long_description: A vertical strip rotated around the x-axis forms a washer with outer and inner radii.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Measure radii from the axis, not from the other curve.

visual_briefs.title: Cylindrical shell from a vertical strip
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show radius, height, circumference, and thickness.
visual_briefs.composition: Vertical strip at x rotating around y-axis into shell; labels x, height, dx.
visual_briefs.long_description: A vertical strip at distance x from the y-axis forms a shell of radius x and height top-bottom.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not confuse shell radius with function height.

visual_briefs.title: Polygonal approximation to arc length
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show a curve approximated by many short chord segments.
visual_briefs.composition: Smooth curve with adjustable number of line segments and total length estimate.
visual_briefs.long_description: A curve is approximated by polygonal chords whose total length approaches arc length.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not describe dx and dy as independent finite legs in the final formula.

visual_briefs.title: Balance point of a nonuniform rod
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show density, weighted moment, and center of mass location.
visual_briefs.composition: Rod with varying shading, labeled center of mass and two sample mass elements.
visual_briefs.long_description: A nonuniform rod balances at x-bar, shifted toward the denser side.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not imply center of mass must be geometric midpoint.

visual_briefs.title: Work as force-distance accumulation
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show force curve and thin work contribution F(x)dx.
visual_briefs.composition: Force versus position graph with shaded strip and accumulated work area.
visual_briefs.long_description: Area under a force-position graph has units newton-meters and equals work.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Do not graph force versus time for a force-distance work integral without a change of variables.

visual_briefs.title: A horizontal liquid slice lifted to an outlet
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show slice volume, weight, lift distance, and tank geometry.
visual_briefs.composition: Vertical tank diagram with movable horizontal slice and labeled A(y), dy, distance D(y).
visual_briefs.long_description: A thin liquid layer at height y has volume A(y)dy and must be lifted D(y).
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Keep density, weight density, and mass density distinct.

visual_briefs.title: Pressure increasing with depth on a submerged plate
visual_briefs.learning_purpose: Show horizontal strip, depth, pressure, strip width, and force.
visual_briefs.composition: Submerged vertical plate with waterline and movable horizontal strip.
visual_briefs.long_description: Pressure arrows grow with depth; force on strip equals pressure times strip area.
visual_briefs.misconception_control: Depth is measured below surface, not from tank bottom unless coordinates are converted.
